adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, when `refresh_token` is absent it is forcibly set to the literal string `"refresh_token"` (lines ~24-27). Call sites then spread `tokenResponse.data` back into stored credentials (e.g., Office365: `o365AuthCredentials = { ...o365AuthCredentials, ...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data) };`), which would overwrite a previously valid `refresh_token` with the placeholder, silently corrupting credentials and breaking future refreshes when the minimum schema branch is used.
